_meta.description: Manually curated factor values per ISO-2 country. Top-level keys are factor IDs; values map ISO-2 → { value, year, source, url, note? }. Anything not in here is filled by fetch scripts (or rendered as 'no data' in the UI).

_meta.factor: Total data centre electricity demand forecast for ~2027 (TWh).
_meta.default_source: IEA Electricity 2024 — DC/AI/crypto demand category (2026 forecast), extrapolated to 2027 using the report's reported growth trajectory. National scaling cross-checked against JLL EMEA Data Centres Q4 2024 and Cushman & Wakefield Global Data Center Market Comparison 2024. Numbers are analyst-derived estimates; replace with vendor-licensed forecasts where available.

IE.source: EirGrid Generation Capacity Statement 2025-2034 — DC trajectory 9.4 TWh (2025) → 14.6 TWh (2034); 2027 interpolated
IE.note: EirGrid forecasts DC share rising to ~28% of national grid demand by 2031

GB.source: NESO Future Energy Scenarios 2024 — UK DC demand 7.6 TWh (today) → 22 TWh (2030); 2027 mid-trajectory

DE.source: Bitkom DC trajectory: 20 TWh (2024) → ~31 TWh (2030); 24 TWh in 2027 mid-trajectory

NL.source: Stedin Amsterdam DSO connection forecasts + IEA Electricity 2024
NL.note: At upper end of credible range; assumes full Microsoft + Google pipeline lights up

DK.source: Energinet long-term forecast + IEA Electricity 2024 (Nordic hyperscale cluster)
DK.note: DC share of national electricity forecast to reach ~14% by 2030

_meta.factor: Typical end-to-end wait in years from a new >50 MW grid-connection application to energisation. Sourced from each national TSO's most recent published connection queue statistics (2024). Where a single number is misleading because of regional variation, the median across primary load centres is used.

GB.source: NESO TEC Register — average wait for transmission-connected demand >50 MW

IE.source: EirGrid 'Shaping our Electricity Future' — DC connection moratorium in Dublin region

NL.source: TenneT NL congestion map — 'transportbeperking' across Randstad
NL.note: Most of NL is currently congestion-restricted; new large loads queued behind grid reinforcements.

FR.source: RTE 'Schéma décennal de développement du réseau' 2024

ES.source: REE 'Planificación de la red de transporte 2021-2026'

AE.source: EWEC / DEWA / TAQA — hyperscale DC connection precedents 2023-2024

SA.source: Saudi Electricity Company — SAR 472 bn ($126 bn) 2024-2030 T&D capex programme implies fast-track industrial connections; MEED reporting
SA.note: URL repointed from se.com.sa (returns HTTP 500) to MEED coverage of SEC capex disclosure.

_meta.factor: Total forecast or committed transmission + distribution grid investment through 2030 (USD billion). Sourced from each national TSO's published 10-year network development plan (TYNDP for EU; equivalent national plans elsewhere). Converted to USD at end-2024 spot rate. Where the published plan extends beyond 2030 (e.g. 2045) the figure is pro-rated linearly.

GB.source: Ofgem RIIO-T3 (~£35 bn transmission) + ED2 distribution (~£23 bn) + wider programme to 2031 = ~£80 bn (~$100 bn)

DE.source: BNetzA NEP 2037/2045 (€360-390 bn full horizon to 2045) pro-rated to 2030 segment ≈ €85-100 bn (~$100 bn)
DE.note: Full-horizon plan extends to 2045; figure shown is the 2024-2030 segment only.

FR.source: RTE SDDR 2024 (€35-50 bn transmission to 2030) + Enedis (~€30-40 bn) = ~€65-90 bn (~$85 bn)

ES.source: REE 'Planificación de la red de transporte 2021-2026' + 2027-2030 outlook

NL.source: TenneT NL investment plan + Stedin/Liander distribution capex

IE.source: EirGrid Shaping Our Electricity Future + ESB Networks PR5

CH.source: Swissgrid Strategic Grid 2040 — CHF 5.5 bn (~USD 6 bn) total to 2040; ~CHF 3-4 bn (~USD 4 bn) to 2030 segment
CH.note: Corrected from prior $12 bn; Swissgrid Apr 2025 announcement confirms CHF 5.5 bn full programme value through 2040, of which the 2030 segment is ~70%.

AE.source: DEWA Strategy 2030 + EWEC + TAQA transmission capex

SA.source: Saudi Electricity Company — SAR 472 bn (~USD 126 bn) 2024-2030 T&D capex programme: SAR 351 bn transmission + SAR 116 bn distribution
SA.note: Corrected from prior $120 bn rough; precise figure SAR 472 bn ≈ USD 126 bn per MEED reporting of SEC disclosure.
